keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «지구의 물은 물의 순환 속에서 계속 움직인다(주제)» 와 «그래서 같은 물이 계속 다시 쓰인다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (water on Earth is always moving in the water cycle) and the conclusion (the same water is used again and again). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The same water is used again and again

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: a never-ending journey called the water cycle
something that happens again and again in the same order
water in the form of a gas
when water changes into a gas

qs.q: Why does water vapor turn back into tiny drops of water high in the sky?
qs.qko: 하늘 높은 곳에서 수증기가 다시 작은 물방울로 바뀌는 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Because the air is cool there
Because the sun is hotter there
Because the drops are already heavy
evs: High in the sky, the air is cool, so the water vapor turns back into tiny drops of water.
First, the sun heats water in oceans, lakes, and rivers.
When the drops become too big and heavy, they fall as rain or snow.
The water then flows into rivers and oceans or soaks into the ground.
why: 하늘 높은 곳은 공기가 차가워서 수증기가 다시 작은 물방울로 바뀐다고 했어요.
High in the sky, the air is cool, so the water vapor turns back into tiny drops.

qs.q: The water cycle is called a «never-ending» journey. What does «never-ending» mean?
qs.qko: 물의 순환을 «never-ending» 여행이라고 했어요. «never-ending» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: Then the cycle starts all over again, so the same water is used again and again.
These drops gather together and form clouds, and this step is called condensation.
First, the sun heats water in oceans, lakes, and rivers.
why: 순환이 처음부터 다시 시작되어 같은 물이 계속 쓰인다고 했으니, «never-ending» 은 «끝나지 않는» 이라는 뜻이에요.
The cycle starts all over again and the same water is used again and again, so «never-ending» means it never stops.

qs.q: How do clouds turn into rain or snow?
opts: Drops gather in clouds and fall when they become too big and heavy
The sun heats the clouds until they disappear
evs: These drops gather together and form clouds, and this step is called condensation.
The warm water turns into an invisible gas called water vapor and rises into the air.
When the drops become too big and heavy, they fall as rain or snow.
The water then flows into rivers and oceans or soaks into the ground.
why: 작은 물방울이 모여 구름이 되고, 물방울이 너무 크고 무거워지면 비나 눈으로 떨어져요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Tiny drops gather to form clouds, and when the drops become too big and heavy, they fall as rain or snow. You need both sentences.

ends: How do plants add water to the air?
Why is the ocean salty but rain is not?

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그 결과» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we can do together and the result in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 결과를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: so that we have clean water)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what to make the result clear. (e.g. so that we have clean water)
write.src: “Let’s <u>save water at home</u> so that <u>we always have clean water</u>.”
